Author: Tiberius1OOO
Name: DragonTyper
Description: AFK kick protection built in (UI typing alone does not keep you in the duty — DragonTyper resets the idle timer). Press Start once and it types Keybound Brawler words for the whole minigame. Configurable delay with +/-20% jitter, Letterlock holds, barrier/interrupt priority. Solo — no other plugins required.
Punchline: Keybound Brawler typer with AFK kick protection — Start once, it types the rest.
